body.message:
Please note that we had informed you in advance that the rate for your next extension would be subject to revision based on the current market conditions and availability.

The revised extension rate has been applied in accordance with the management’s decision. We would also like to clarify that this adjustment is not specific to your booking; the updated rates apply to all in-house guests requesting an extension, based on the current market situation.

We completely understand your concern and sincerely appreciate your understanding. However, as the rate adjustment is determined by management and is beyond our control, we are unfortunately unable to offer a reduction or maintain the previous rate.

Thank you for your kind cooperation and understanding.
